enemy-040-pathogen-mimic.designLock: Pathogen Mimic is an original Aliens: Tantalus Frontier PROJECT_ADAPTATION, not a published Cold Iron enemy name and not a pixel-exact canon model. The inspected official Pathogen presentation names Runner, Blight, Brute and Queen but no Pathogen Mimic; it supplies pathogen-family context only. Preserve the project-owned V54 identity: one low, forward-pitched, half-upright human-derived pursuer with a stretched torso, exactly two arms and exactly two legs, asymmetrical claws, ruptured rib growths, compact pathogen sacs and wet exposed sinew. Pallid fungal gray-ivory flesh with restrained bruised beige/cool pink variation; stable asymmetry, recognizable head and thoracic landmarks, no carried weapon, armor or clothing. Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile. Move is a dragging but fast grounded pursuit, not a standard upright biped walk and not a four-legged xenomorph gallop. Attack is a committed wind-up, claw slash and short anatomical bite/impact with follow-through and recovery; no separate xenomorph inner-jaw piston. Death is a contained pathogen-sac rupture followed by irreversible collapse and a terminal body, never an explosion or dissolve. No tail, elongated biomechanical dome, dorsal tubes, fist-growths, extra limbs or ribs/tendons misread as appendages. Use the V54 sheet only for Tantalus identity, palette, low scale and broad motion continuity; do not copy frames. Preserve the same individual, sac placement, claw asymmetry, limb topology and anatomical scale across all clips; no crop, cell contact, official bitmap reuse or canonExact claim.

normalizedAlphaMeasurements.interpretation: All sixteen old cells stop at normalized y=239. Width and height changes reflect rise, pursuit, reach and collapse; they are not inter-clip scale evidence.

strengths: A dedicated Tantalus identity, provenance record and right-facing runtime sheet already exist.
The low half-upright silhouette, fungal pallor, asymmetrical claws and rapid dragging pursuit separate the Mimic from a Drone.
The old four phases provide useful action intent and a stable ground-line precedent.
blockingGaps: Each old row supplies four poses, while V66 requires eight independently authored chronological poses per clip.
The V54 provenance records rejected variants with bodies crossing cell boundaries; V66 cell isolation must be verified before normalization.
The generic queue attack text permits an inner-jaw strike and generic biped motion, both inconsistent with the reviewed project lock.
No external published model can certify the Mimic; identity review must test the Tantalus contract, not canon likeness.

topology.rule: Exactly two shoulders connect to two continuous arms and two asymmetric clawed hands; exactly two hips connect to two continuous legs and feet. Ruptured ribs, tendons, sacs and fungal protrusions are surface anatomy, never extra locomotive limbs, fingers, tails or detached creatures.

referenceLock.silhouette: Low, forward-pitched and half-upright with a stretched human-derived thorax, narrow damaged waist, long dragging limbs, asymmetric claws and compact sacs clustered on stable thoracic/flank landmarks.
referenceLock.material: Pallid fungal gray-ivory flesh with restrained cool pink, bruised beige and translucent wet-sinew accents. Infection creates stable asymmetry without random recoloring, neon glow or decomposed-zombie clothing.
referenceLock.headAndMouth: A small recognizable human-derived head integrated into the stretched torso, with one distorted anatomical mouth suitable for a short bite. No smooth xenomorph dome, visible helmet, Predator mandibles or separate inner-jaw piston.
referenceLock.facing: Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay side view in all 32 future poses.

scale.gameplayRole: Fast low adaptive pursuer retaining the pathogen-mimic-large gameplay class.
scale.rigidLandmark: Measure a repeatable thoracic chord from the posterior scapular/rib-root landmark to the anterior sternum notch and cross-check the hip-to-shoulder socket distance on at least two comparable poses per clip.
scale.forbiddenMetric: Never derive inter-clip scale from claw reach, rib protrusions, sac swelling, global bounding box or corpse width.

rootAndGround.pivotStatus: queue precedent only; requires manual physical-root review after generation
rootAndGround.bodyRoot: Project the pelvis to the support plane beneath the currently loaded foot/leg pair; never anchor to a claw, rib spur, tendon or sac.
rootAndGround.idle: The low half-upright stance remains supported and loopable; twitching does not move the root.
rootAndGround.move: Feet exchange load in a fast dragging pursuit. A hand may swing or brush near the ground but cannot become an added leg or redefine the root.
rootAndGround.attack: Pelvis and rear foot remain the body anchor through the slash-and-bite sequence; reach does not enlarge the hitbox.
rootAndGround.death: The terminal anchor lies under the collapsed pelvis/torso contact, never under a ruptured sac or far claw.

sourceContract.background: true transparent RGBA or perfectly uniform opaque #FF00FF
sourceContract.cellIsolation: Exactly one complete creature per nominal cell; no body, claw, rib growth, sac, tendon or fragment touches or crosses a cell boundary.
sourceContract.identityScale: One common anatomy and source scale across idle, move, attack and death; no automatic per-pose correction.

idle.rule: Eight distinct but restrained supported poses; no locomotion, topology change or full human upright stance.

move.rule: Fast desperate half-upright pursuit with grounded foot exchange; no standard military walk, quadrupedal xenomorph gallop or translation across cells.

attack.rule: One coherent slash-and-bite attack. No separate xenomorph inner jaw, projectile, detached acid, tail strike or extra attacking limb.

poses: one compact sac ruptures without detaching
death.rule: Contained rupture and irreversible collapse; no full-body explosion, dissolve, detached gore cloud, regrowth or living final pose.

prohibitions: No claim that Pathogen Mimic is a published Cold Iron caste or a canon-exact model.
No tail, elongated xenomorph dome, dorsal tubes, Queen crest, Brute fist-growths or black biomechanical shell.
No extra arm, leg, claw, head or creature; ribs, tendons and sacs never become appendages.
No generic inner-jaw attack, upright human walk, quadrupedal Drone sprint, weapon, armor, clothing or equipment.
No neon infection glow, magenta anatomy, painted pathogen cloud, floor, shadow, scenery, text, logo, UI, watermark or checkerboard.
No left-facing pose, perspective turn, crop, cell contact, cross-cell fragment or copied official/licensed bitmap.
